title: Verify: empty and unknown scene transition ignored unit tests
description: With Phaser faked, emit transitionTo with '' and an unknown id.
acceptance_criteria: Given '' emitted, then fadeOut and scene.start are not called
Given an unknown id with scene.get returning null, then they are not called
technical_constraints: Copy the phaser vi.mock of bootSceneTransition.test.ts with scene.get as vi.fn

steps.action: Create the scene as bootSceneTransition.test.ts does with scene.get returning null; call create(); reactToPhaser.emit('transitionTo',{sceneId:''}) then {sceneId:'nope'}; assert cameras.main.fadeOut and scene.start were never called.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneTransitionIgnore.test.ts
